name: mixtura
description: A workbench for mixed drinks: templates, balance numbers, your own specs

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mixtura/engine && npm run build -w @mixtura/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mixtura/engine && npm run typecheck -w @mixtura/app
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e -w @mixtura/app
